title: DNS lookups failing
summary: 2 DNS queries got an error (SERVFAIL/REFUSED) and 1 got no answer within 2s. Applications cannot connect to a name they cannot resolve, so users see 'site can't be reached' even when the network itself works.

title: DNS names that do not exist (NXDOMAIN)
summary: 2 lookups returned NXDOMAIN ('no such name'). 1 look like normal client behaviour (browser probes, search-list or local names). 1 are ordinary names: check for typos, a removed DNS record, or a wrong DNS suffix.

title: Slow DNS responses
summary: 1 lookups took 200 ms or longer. Every new hostname costs this delay before the connection even starts. A single slow lookup is often a cache miss (the resolver had to ask the internet); consistently slow lookups point at the resolver or the path to it. For comparison, 192.168.1.1 answered quickly.
